title: Docshare — share a file, send a link

versions.body:
Send a link, not a stack of paper.

Docshare hosts a file and gives you a URL. Recipients can view it. They cannot edit it. When you have finished with a link, you can let it expire, and it will say so.

This is a public homepage, not a catalogue of every file anyone has ever uploaded. If you were sent a link, open that link. If you do not have one, this page will not invent one for you.

Pricing is simple: a free link for a short time, and a paid link if you need it to stay up.

HARBOR FESTIVAL 2025 — volunteer roster (final)
Pier, Saturday–Sunday.

06:00–12:00  A. Patel, J. Morris, S. Keene (bins)
12:00–18:00  D. Okonkwo, L. Berry, M. Stead
18:00–close  R. Gale, T. Bloom, night sweep: P. Ruiz

Dog run: two people at all times, rota on the shed door.
First aid is the tent by the steps, not the food row.

Uploaded by: festival.volunteers

EASTFIELD PTA — cake sale
Saturday 11 April, 10:00–13:00, school yard (or hall if it rains).

Please bring: one cake, or a tray of buns, labelled if there are nuts.
We need two tables and a cash box. Sign-up on the sheet in the office.

Leftovers go to the staff room. Do not leave cream cakes in the sun.

Uploaded by: eastfield.pta

SEATING PLAN — draft 3 (please don't circulate)
Hall, 4 April.

Table 1: the couple, both mothers, both fathers, officiant.
Table 2: aunts (window side).
Table 3: college friends. Do not sit J. next to M.
Table 4: work people, plus two spare seats.
Table 5: everyone we forgot in draft 2.

Still unplaced: cousin with the dog (the dog is not invited).

Uploaded by: r.and.t.drafts

THE HARBOR VAN
Thursday–Sunday, north dock, from noon.

Chowder, cup or bowl
Fish roll
Something fried with peas
Tea, coffee, a bun if we baked

Card or cash. We run out. We will say so.

Uploaded by: harbor.van

The file is gone, or the link was allowed to lapse.

Docshare does not keep a public copy after a link expires. If you still need the file, ask the person who sent you the URL.
